        <div class="td-content">
          
            <h1>Authenticating Meshery via CLI</h1>
          
          <p>To authenticate Meshery through <code>mesheryctl</code>, the Meshery CLI, you will use the <code>mesheryctl system login</code> command. On executing this command, you will be provided with a list of providers to choose from. You can then select a Provider of your choice to complete the authentication and authorization process.</p>
<p>As of this writing, you will be presented with two providers, <em>Meshery</em> and <em>None</em>.</p>
<div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" class="chroma"><code class="language-bash" data-lang="bash"><span class="line"><span class="cl">Use the arrow keys to navigate: ↓ ↑ → ← 
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">? Select a Provider: 
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">  ▸ Meshery
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">    None
</span></span></code></pre></div><ul>
<li>
<p>Selecting <em>Meshery</em> will open a browser to complete the login and authentication process with Meshery Cloud. On successful authentication, you can close the window and return to the command prompt.</p>
<p>Verify that an <code>auth.json</code> file was created in the <code>.meshery</code> folder in your home directory.</p>
<div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" class="chroma"><code class="language-bash" data-lang="bash"><span class="line"><span class="cl">ls -l <span class="nv">$HOME</span>/.meshery/
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">total <span class="m">12</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">-rw-rw-r-- <span class="m">1</span> ubuntu ubuntu  <span class="m">39</span> Dec <span class="m">21</span> 06:13 auth.json
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">-rw-rw-r-- <span class="m">1</span> ubuntu ubuntu <span class="m">260</span> Dec <span class="m">21</span> 06:04 config.yaml
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">-rw-rw-r-- <span class="m">1</span> ubuntu ubuntu <span class="m">988</span> Dec <span class="m">21</span> 06:04 meshery.yaml
</span></span></code></pre></div><p><strong><em>The need for authentication to <code>Meshery</code> <a href="/v0.9/extensibility/providers/">provider</a> is to save your environment setup while also having persistent/steady sessions and to be able to retrieve performance test results.</em></strong></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Selecting <em>None</em> will create an empty <code>auth.json</code> file. All your work remains local and ephemeral.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>If <code>mesheryctl</code> is running in a system that does not have a browser, you can download an auth token file from your Meshery Cloud account and copy it into the <code>.meshery</code> folder in your home directory. The following steps show how you can generate and download a token:</p>
<ol>
<li>Navigate to <a href="https://cloud.meshery.io/security/tokens">https://cloud.meshery.io/security/tokens</a> and sign-in.
Ensure you are in the right organization and click <strong>Create</strong>.</li>
</ol>
<p><a href="/guides/mesheryctl/images/create-token.png"><img alt="Create Token" src="/guides/mesheryctl/images/create-token.png" /></a></p>
<ol start="2">
<li>
<p>Provide a token name and purpose. Click <strong>Create</strong> to generate.</p>
<p><a href="/guides/mesheryctl/images/generate-token.png"><img alt="Generate Token" src="/guides/mesheryctl/images/generate-token.png" /></a></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Click the <strong>Download</strong> icon to download the <code>auth.json</code> file.</p>
<p><a href="/guides/mesheryctl/images/download-token.png"><img alt="Download Token" src="/guides/mesheryctl/images/download-token.png" /></a></p>
</li>
</ol>
<p>Then run <code>mesheryctl system check</code> to ensure you do not see an authentication error.</p>
<p>For an exhaustive list of <code>mesheryctl</code> commands and syntax, visit <a href="/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/"><code>mesheryctl</code> Command Reference</a>.</p>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
          
            <h1>Configuring Autocompletion for `mesheryctl`</h1>
          
          <p>If you would like to have <code>mesheryctl</code> commands automatically completed for use as you use <code>mesheryctl</code>, then use the following instructions to configure automatic completion within your environment.</p>
<h2 id="autocompletion-for-bash">
	Autocompletion for Bash
</h2>
<h3 id="bash--32">
	bash &lt;= 3.2
</h3>
 <pre class="codeblock-pre"><div class="codeblock">
 <div class="clipboardjs">source /dev/stdin <<< "$(mesheryctl completion bash)"</div></div>
 </pre>
<h3 id="bash--40">
	bash &gt;= 4.0
</h3>
 <pre class="codeblock-pre"><div class="codeblock">
 <div class="clipboardjs">source <(mesheryctl completion bash)</div></div>
 </pre>
<h3 id="bash--32-on-macos">
	bash &lt;= 3.2 on MacOS
</h3>
 <pre class="codeblock-pre"><div class="codeblock">
 <div class="clipboardjs">brew install bash-completion # ensure you have bash-completion 1.3+
mesheryctl completion bash > $(brew --prefix)/etc/bash_completion.d/mesheryctl</div></div>
 </pre>
<h3 id="bash--40-on-macos">
	bash &gt;= 4.0 on MacOS
</h3>
 <pre class="codeblock-pre"><div class="codeblock">
 <div class="clipboardjs">brew install bash-completion@2
mesheryctl completion bash > $(brew --prefix)/etc/bash_completion.d/mesheryctl</div></div>
 </pre>
<h2 id="autocompletion-for-zsh">
	Autocompletion for zsh
</h2>
 <pre class="codeblock-pre"><div class="codeblock">
 <div class="clipboardjs">source <(mesheryctl completion zsh)</div></div>
 </pre><br>
<p>If shell completion is not already enabled in your environment you will need to enable it. You can execute the following once:</p>
 <pre class="codeblock-pre"><div class="codeblock">
 <div class="clipboardjs">~/.zshrc > echo "autoload -U compinit; compinit"</div></div>
 </pre>
<p><em>Note</em> : You might need to restart your shell for this setup to take effect.</p>
<h4 id="zsh-on-macos-and-oh-my-zsh">
	zsh on MacOS and Oh My zsh
</h4>
 <pre class="codeblock-pre"><div class="codeblock">
 <div class="clipboardjs">COMPLETION_DIR=$(echo $fpath | grep -o '[^ ]*completions' | grep -v cache) && mkdir -p $COMPLETION_DIR && mesheryctl completion zsh > "${COMPLETION_DIR}/_mesheryctl"</div></div>
 </pre>
<h3 id="autocompletion-for-fish">
	Autocompletion for fish
</h3>
 <pre class="codeblock-pre"><div class="codeblock">
 <div class="clipboardjs">mesheryctl completion fish | source</div></div>
 </pre><br>
<p>To load fish shell completions for each session, execute once:</p>
 <pre class="codeblock-pre"><div class="codeblock">
 <div class="clipboardjs">mesheryctl completion fish > ~/.config/fish/completions/mesheryctl.fish</div></div>
 </pre>
<p>For an exhaustive list of <code>mesheryctl</code> commands and syntax:</p>
<ul>
<li>See <a href="/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/"><code>mesheryctl</code> Command Reference</a>.</li>
</ul>
<p>Guides to using Meshery&rsquo;s various features and components.</p>

        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);

            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

    <item>
      <title>Authenticating Meshery via CLI</title>
      <link>/v0.9/guides/mesheryctl/authenticate-with-meshery-via-cli/</link>
      <pubDate>Mon, 01 Jan 0001 00:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
      <guid>/v0.9/guides/mesheryctl/authenticate-with-meshery-via-cli/</guid>
      <description>&lt;p&gt;To authenticate Meshery through &lt;code&gt;mesheryctl&lt;/code&gt;, the Meshery CLI, you will use the &lt;code&gt;mesheryctl system login&lt;/code&gt; command. On executing this command, you will be provided with a list of providers to choose from. You can then select a Provider of your choice to complete the authentication and authorization process.&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;As of this writing, you will be presented with two providers, &lt;em&gt;Meshery&lt;/em&gt; and &lt;em&gt;None&lt;/em&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#34;highlight&#34;&gt;&lt;pre tabindex=&#34;0&#34; class=&#34;chroma&#34;&gt;&lt;code class=&#34;language-bash&#34; data-lang=&#34;bash&#34;&gt;&lt;span class=&#34;line&#34;&gt;&lt;span class=&#34;cl&#34;&gt;Use the arrow keys to navigate: ↓ ↑ → ← &#xA;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&#34;line&#34;&gt;&lt;span class=&#34;cl&#34;&gt;? Select a Provider: &#xA;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&#34;line&#34;&gt;&lt;span class=&#34;cl&#34;&gt;  ▸ Meshery&#xA;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&#34;line&#34;&gt;&lt;span class=&#34;cl&#34;&gt;    None&#xA;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/pre&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;ul&gt;&#xA;&lt;li&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Selecting &lt;em&gt;Meshery&lt;/em&gt; will open a browser to complete the login and authentication process with Meshery Cloud. On successful authentication, you can close the window and return to the command prompt.&lt;/p&gt;</description>
    </item>
    <item>
      <title>Configuring Autocompletion for `mesheryctl`</title>
      <link>/v0.9/guides/mesheryctl/configuring-autocompletion-for-mesheryctl/</link>
      <pubDate>Mon, 01 Jan 0001 00:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
      <guid>/v0.9/guides/mesheryctl/configuring-autocompletion-for-mesheryctl/</guid>
      <description>&lt;p&gt;If you would like to have &lt;code&gt;mesheryctl&lt;/code&gt; commands automatically completed for use as you use &lt;code&gt;mesheryctl&lt;/code&gt;, then use the following instructions to configure automatic completion within your environment.&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;autocompletion-for-bash&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Autocompletion for Bash&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;h3 id=&#34;bash--32&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;bash &amp;lt;= 3.2&#xA;&lt;/h3&gt;&#xA; &lt;pre class=&#34;codeblock-pre&#34;&gt;&lt;div class=&#34;codeblock&#34;&gt;&#xA; &lt;div class=&#34;clipboardjs&#34;&gt;source /dev/stdin &lt;&lt;&lt; &#34;$(mesheryctl completion bash)&#34;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA; &lt;/pre&gt;&#xA;&lt;h3 id=&#34;bash--40&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;bash &amp;gt;= 4.0&#xA;&lt;/h3&gt;&#xA; &lt;pre class=&#34;codeblock-pre&#34;&gt;&lt;div class=&#34;codeblock&#34;&gt;&#xA; &lt;div class=&#34;clipboardjs&#34;&gt;source &lt;(mesheryctl completion bash)&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA; &lt;/pre&gt;&#xA;&lt;h3 id=&#34;bash--32-on-macos&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;bash &amp;lt;= 3.2 on MacOS&#xA;&lt;/h3&gt;&#xA; &lt;pre class=&#34;codeblock-pre&#34;&gt;&lt;div class=&#34;codeblock&#34;&gt;&#xA; &lt;div class=&#34;clipboardjs&#34;&gt;brew install bash-completion # ensure you have bash-completion 1.3+&#xA;mesheryctl completion bash &gt; $(brew --prefix)/etc/bash_completion.d/mesheryctl&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA; &lt;/pre&gt;&#xA;&lt;h3 id=&#34;bash--40-on-macos&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;bash &amp;gt;= 4.0 on MacOS&#xA;&lt;/h3&gt;&#xA; &lt;pre class=&#34;codeblock-pre&#34;&gt;&lt;div class=&#34;codeblock&#34;&gt;&#xA; &lt;div class=&#34;clipboardjs&#34;&gt;brew install bash-completion@2&#xA;mesheryctl completion bash &gt; $(brew --prefix)/etc/bash_completion.d/mesheryctl&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA; &lt;/pre&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;autocompletion-for-zsh&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Autocompletion for zsh&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA; &lt;pre class=&#34;codeblock-pre&#34;&gt;&lt;div class=&#34;codeblock&#34;&gt;&#xA; &lt;div class=&#34;clipboardjs&#34;&gt;source &lt;(mesheryctl completion zsh)&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA; &lt;/pre&gt;&lt;br&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;If shell completion is not already enabled in your environment you will need to enable it. You can execute the following once:&lt;/p&gt;</description>
    </item>
    <item>
      <title>Mesheryctl system commands</title>
      <link>/v0.9/guides/mesheryctl/system-commands/</link>
      <pubDate>Mon, 01 Jan 0001 00:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
      <guid>/v0.9/guides/mesheryctl/system-commands/</guid>
      <description>&lt;p&gt;Let&amp;rsquo;s get familiar with mesheryctl system commands. The syntax of the mesheryctl commands goes as follws : &lt;code&gt;mesheryctl &amp;lt;Main_command&amp;gt; &amp;lt;Argument&amp;gt; &amp;lt;Flags&amp;gt;&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;main_command--system&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Main_command : system&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;h3 id=&#34;start&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;start&#xA;&lt;/h3&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;&lt;code&gt;mesheryctl system start&lt;/code&gt; : This will initiate Meshery &amp;amp; automatically open it in your default web browser.&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;&lt;a href=&#34;/v0.9/guides/mesheryctl/images/start.png&#34;&gt;&lt;img alt=&#34;skip-browser&#34; style=&#34;width:500px;height:auto;&#34; src=&#34;/v0.9/guides/mesheryctl/images/start.png&#34; /&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;&lt;code&gt;mesheryctl system start --skip-browser&lt;/code&gt; : It skips opening Meshery in your browser with the provided URL.&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;&lt;a href=&#34;/v0.9/guides/mesheryctl/images/skipbrowser.png&#34;&gt;&lt;img alt=&#34;skip-browser&#34; style=&#34;width:500px;height:auto;&#34; src=&#34;/v0.9/guides/mesheryctl/images/skipbrowser.png&#34; /&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;&lt;code&gt;mesheryctl system start --skip-update&lt;/code&gt; : It is used when you want to skip updating Meshery if an update is available.&lt;/p&gt;</description>
    </item>
    <item>
      <title>Running system checks using Meshery CLI</title>
      <link>/v0.9/guides/mesheryctl/running-system-checks-using-mesheryctl/</link>
      <pubDate>Mon, 01 Jan 0001 00:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
      <guid>/v0.9/guides/mesheryctl/running-system-checks-using-mesheryctl/</guid>
      <description>&lt;p&gt;Meshery&amp;rsquo;s CLI, &lt;code&gt;mesheryctl&lt;/code&gt;, includes commands for verifying system readiness for a Meshery deployment and health checks to confirm the health of an existing Meshery deployment. Whether you have yet to deploy Meshery or have already deployed Meshery, &lt;code&gt;mesheryctl system check&lt;/code&gt; is a useful utility to ensure that your Meshery deployments are healthy.&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#34;codeblock-pre&#34;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#34;codeblock&#34;&gt;&lt;div class=&#34;clipboardjs&#34;&gt;mesheryctl system check&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;&lt;br/&gt;&lt;p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#34;codeblock-pre&#34;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#34;codeblock&#34;&gt;&lt;div class=&#34;clipboardjs&#34;&gt;Verify environment pre/post-deployment of Meshery.&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Usage:&#xA;mesheryctl system check [flags]&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Flags:&#xA;&amp;ndash;adapter Check status of Meshery adapters&#xA;-h, &amp;ndash;help help for check&#xA;&amp;ndash;operator Check status of Meshery operators&#xA;&amp;ndash;pre Verify environment readiness to deploy Meshery&#xA;&amp;ndash;preflight Verify environment readiness to deploy Meshery&lt;/p&gt;</description>
    </item>
    <item>
      <title>Using Meshery CLI</title>
      <link>/v0.9/guides/mesheryctl/working-with-mesheryctl/</link>
      <pubDate>Mon, 01 Jan 0001 00:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
      <guid>/v0.9/guides/mesheryctl/working-with-mesheryctl/</guid>
      <description>&lt;p&gt;Meshery&amp;rsquo;s command line interface is &lt;code&gt;mesheryctl&lt;/code&gt;. Use &lt;code&gt;mesheryctl&lt;/code&gt; to both manage the lifecyle of Meshery itself and to access and invoke any of Meshery&amp;rsquo;s application and cloud native management functions. &lt;code&gt;mesheryctl&lt;/code&gt; commands can be categorized as follows:&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;ul&gt;&#xA;&lt;li&gt;&lt;code&gt;mesheryctl&lt;/code&gt; - Global overrides and flags&lt;/li&gt;&#xA;&lt;li&gt;&lt;code&gt;mesheryctl app&lt;/code&gt; - Cloud Native Application Management&lt;/li&gt;&#xA;&lt;li&gt;&lt;code&gt;mesheryctl filter&lt;/code&gt; - Cloud Native Filter Management&lt;/li&gt;&#xA;&lt;li&gt;&lt;code&gt;mesheryctl mesh&lt;/code&gt; - Cloud Native Lifecycle &amp;amp; Configuration Management&lt;/li&gt;&#xA;&lt;li&gt;&lt;code&gt;mesheryctl perf&lt;/code&gt; - Cloud Native Performance Management&lt;/li&gt;&#xA;&lt;li&gt;&lt;code&gt;mesheryctl design&lt;/code&gt; - Cloud Native Pattern Configuration &amp;amp; Management&lt;/li&gt;&#xA;&lt;li&gt;&lt;code&gt;mesheryctl system&lt;/code&gt; - Meshery Lifecycle and Troubleshooting&lt;/li&gt;&#xA;&lt;/ul&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;configuring-meshery-deployments-with-meshconfig&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Configuring Meshery Deployments with meshconfig&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;Meshconfig&lt;/em&gt; refers to a configuration file found at &lt;code&gt;~/.meshery/config.yaml&lt;/code&gt;. Your meshconfig file must contain one or more &lt;code&gt;contexts&lt;/code&gt; in order for any &lt;code&gt;mesheryctl system&lt;/code&gt; command to work. Each context represents a Meshery deployment.&lt;/p&gt;</description>
    </item>
  </channel>
</rss>
